Recorded claim:
Dependency writes through `depends_on` or `blocks` must invalidate linked Bugzilla cache records. Cache generations prevent stale in-flight reads from restoring old state. Build a created sprint from returned ID/inputs if refresh fails; rollover adds stories to the new sprint before removing them from the old sprint, then resolves the old sprint. [Task 2]
